summary: Purchase: Snowflake Connector enterprise seats, 12-month support, and regional connectors
description:
Issue summary:
Data Platform requests procurement of Snowflake enterprise connector licenses for cross-region data ingestion and managed connector support. Request covers 6 developer seats (non-prod), 2 production connector licenses (multi-attach), and Snowflake Premium Connector Support (12 months).

Business impact:
- Enables Data Platform to stabilize ingestion pipelines across EU and US regions for two upcoming feature launches (audit logs and customer analytics).
- Current DIY connectors are fragile and costly to maintain; vendor-managed connectors will reduce incident load on Platform SRE and lower MTTR.

Requested items:
- 6 x Snowflake Connector Developer Seats (non-prod)
- 2 x Snowflake Production Connector Licenses (multi-region)
- 12 months Snowflake Premium Connector Support
- Onboarding assistance (2-day remote session)

Justification / ROI:
- Expected 30% reduction in pipeline incidents and ~0.3 FTE savings in SRE maintenance time.
- Needed to meet SLAs for customer-facing reporting features slated for Q3.

Budget & approvals:
- Estimated annual cost: USD 54,600 (quote v1).
- Proposed budget charge: DP-2026-Q2-0041.

Deadlines:
- Required for pre-launch integration testing by 2026-03-29; procurement requested by 2026-03-22 to allow PO issuance and onboarding scheduling.

Contacts:
- Requester: Asha Menon (Data Platform PM)
- Technical lead: Miguel Alvarez (Platform Eng)
- Vendor contact: Julia Park, Snowflake Sales (j.park@snowflake.com)

Attachments / references:
- Vendor quote: vendor_quote_url
- Internal onboarding checklist: related_confluence_pages[0]

Notes on scope:
- This request is for Redwood-managed tenancy connectors (vendor-managed) rather than self-hosted connector code. Ensure MSSA review for the support add-on and data handling terms.
